title: Number of Teachers Trained to Teach Special Needs Students
what_it_is: Number of Teachers Trained to Teach Special Needs Students

sections.label: Specialised schools SEN resourcing
sections.summary: Four schools have smaller enrolment, more resourcing, better teacher-student ratios, specialised SEN staff, and trained teachers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Their enrolment is smaller than other typical schools and they also receive a higher level of resourcing to support students, including those with SEN.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: As a result, they have a better teacher to student ratio, and they use the additional funds to hire specialised manpower to support SEN students.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Typically, each of them has about 10 such specialised staff who support students' additional needs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: All teachers in these four schools have gone through SEN awareness training and receive regular professional development in SEN knowledge and skills.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: About 15% of the teachers have a higher level of training, such as the Teachers Trained in Special Needs (TSN) course offered by the National Institute of Education.

sections.label: Specialised schools intake diagnosed SEN
sections.summary: At least half of the last intake at the four schools were students diagnosed with special needs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: The recent update that we got was that out of these four schools, at least half of their last intake is made up of students who are diagnosed with special needs.

sections.label: ITE SEN student intake
sections.summary: More than 50% of ITE student intake being SEN students is known and hoped to improve.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: On the point about more than 50% of the student intake at ITE being SEN students, this is something we are aware of and something that we hope that we will continue to improve on.

sections.label: Specialised schools employ trained staff
sections.summary: The four specialised schools have funds to employ their own teachers and para-educators with special needs training.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Beyond that, the four specialised schools also would have funds to employ their own teachers and para-educators who would have the special needs training as well.
